### 1.2 Sample efficiency vs compute (tabular 10 bins vs best DQN)
- steps to first greedy >= 475: tabular 382k vs DQN 56k -> DQN is 6.9x more SAMPLE-efficient
- CPU per env step: tabular 0.097 ms vs DQN 2.243 ms -> 23x
- CPU-seconds to reach 475: tabular 37 s vs DQN 124 s -> tabular is 3.4x more COMPUTE-efficient
- greedy return at an EQUAL budget of 200k steps (mean of checkpoints 180k-200k): tabular_bins6 174.1 ± 24.7 (n=10); tabular_bins10 174.9 ± 16.3 (n=10); tabular_bins20 214.9 ± 27.8 (n=10); dqn_eps5k 355.6 ± 95.4 (n=10); dqn_eps25k 296.1 ± 83.5 (n=10)
- Welch t-test DQN(eps5k) vs tabular(10 bins) at 200k: t = 4.22, p = 0.002

### 1.3 Number of bins: precision vs data
- tabular_bins6: 1,296 states, visited 38.7% (~502 states); final 355.8 ± 51.0 (n=10); seed-to-seed std of final = 71
- tabular_bins10: 10,000 states, visited 18.0% (~1,801 states); final 392.2 ± 81.4 (n=10); seed-to-seed std of final = 114
- tabular_bins20: 160,000 states, visited 4.6% (~7,382 states); final 263.0 ± 95.8 (n=10); seed-to-seed std of final = 134
- Welch t-test final(6 bins) vs final(20 bins): t = 1.93, p = 0.074

- Q-value level vs policy quality. Mean Q on training batches (discounted value of arbitrary visited states) is not directly comparable to an episode return, so we compare it ACROSS configs: a config whose Q is far above full DQN's while its policy is far worse is overestimating.
  - full: final mean Q 43.4 (1.00x full DQN) with final greedy return 233.7
  - no_target: final mean Q 48.4 (1.11x full DQN) with final greedy return 176.1
  - no_replay: final mean Q 256.9 (5.92x full DQN) with final greedy return -375.9
  - double: final mean Q 43.2 (1.00x full DQN) with final greedy return 234.2
  - dueling: final mean Q 46.9 (1.08x full DQN) with final greedy return 238.2
- no_target: seeds that reached >=200 and later fell below 0: 10/10
- no_replay: seeds that reached >=200 and later fell below 0: 2/10
- full: seeds that reached >=200 and later fell below 0: 2/10
- double: seeds that reached >=200 and later fell below 0: 4/10
- dueling: seeds that reached >=200 and later fell below 0: 3/10
